summary: Spec fidelity, out of this change: a second shell-word quoter, canon_gate::audit::shell_quote, still exists beside atip::quote with a different safe set (`%` allowed, `@` not), used by evidence.rs for audit commands. The brief moves only the next-step rules, canon-gate has no atip dependency, and unifying would change bytes, so leaving it is correct here; recorded so L1 (0.34) decides which quoting the contract names.
